title: YouTube sticks new labels on AI-generated songs
key_facts: YouTube is adding a "Made with AI" label to tracks "altered or fully generated" with AI
The label starts in the YouTube Music app and comes to the main YouTube app later
It covers music made "primarily" with generative AI, for example using a generative model to create the composition and vocals
YouTube says it works with music partners and uses its own detection tools
Under partner rules, if a song is not disclosed YouTube may use "other signals" to decide it is AI-generated
Tapping the label on the player page opens a menu with more information
Spotify has a voluntary AI label, Apple Music is reportedly getting an AI tag, Deezer added an AI filter switch and Bandcamp banned AI music
quote_evidence: YouTube is adding a "Made with AI" label to tracks that were "altered or fully generated" using AI.
The label is rolling out starting today in the YouTube Music app, and expanding to the main YouTube app later.
why_it_matters_hint: Listeners get a visible signal about whether a track was made mainly by AI.
